Independent literal runtime values/cursors and typed lexical expectations test assignment/return/hash/spaced/repeated/single-quote/Unicode-CRLF routes. Complete original regular Git snapshots conservatively retain every parent blob; this is not a minimal observed-IO inventory. Black-box Gitlink/nonregular metadata exclude payload reads. Four replacements are MethodLowering, BoundaryLabels, the prior quoted fixture and Phase0; three overlays are new cases/probe/test. Full source reconstruction restores the original owners outside one serializer helper/import/branch, decoder helpers, two removed runtime skips and one recurring Phase0 subtest. No callback dispatch, AST schema, helper discovery/Contracts/runtime emitter, ordinary string/number semantics, source-coordinate authority, broad equal-text mapping, new grammar/backend/capability/CI/toolchain/dependency/storage changes. All raw streams are retained losslessly/hash-bound; comparisons normalize only exact clock headers in existing NONE-level failure traces and separately retain the scoped debug trace. All other unchanged public channels are exact. P1 SPEC-LANGUAGE-SELF-CONTAINMENT.1.3.3.0.7.2.2 owns quoted-marker generated-handler compile failure after source-producer prerequisites before quoted closeout; five excluded grammar cases remain unresolved, not accepted features. Anonymous provenance and other families, executable/comment membership, zero-argument portability, other backend escape handling and global history audit remain separately owned. Actual source_span_missing disappears on the bounded repaired route. Focused proof is not canonical CI; family .1.4.7 and final clean push require canonical proof. Read-only OS/Perl/prove/Python/mdBook are host prerequisites; owned inputs/outputs and workspaces remain on repository volume.
